title: Power Apps: modern, refreshed look reaches the mail app on the semi-annual channel
summary: The roadmap supports the mail app refresh, its automatic availability and its October target, and Microsoft documents the licensing requirement and release-channel API. Minor corrections should complete the setting path, explain conflicting environment-channel guidance and remove the checklist instruction for a control absent from the table.
